title: Medal of the Patriot Refugees
source_text:
Medal of the Patriot Refugees Home Europe Asia America Africa Oceania Links Back Tags list Allies Research Back Societies Forums Back All updates Album sheets Reference Catalogue Search Medal of the Patriot Refugees Medal instituted by Emperor Haile Selassie I on 30 November 1944. Medal awarded to patriots who went into exile and participated in the liberation struggle. Medal have single class. Torches added to medal ribbon for each year of service.
